title: RAG-Coding：利用结构化外部知识增强LLM医疗编码
summary: 提出RAG-Coding方法，通过编排四个LLM代理并基于外部知识源（如官方编码表和指南）进行编码决策，提升ICD-10-CM自动编码的准确性和临床合规性。在MDACE数据集上，微F1和宏F1分别比最佳LLM基线高8-13%和2-8%。同时发布了更新至2025年指南的MDACE-2025数据集。
summary_en: We present RAG-Coding, an agentic method for automated ICD-10-CM coding that orchestrates four LLM agents and grounds decisions in external knowledge sources, outperforming LLM baselines by 8-13% micro-F1 and 2-8% macro-F1 on MDACE. Also releases MDACE-2025 with updated 2025 guidelines.
